Rowshan Ara Begum and others----- Appellants

full_judgment:
The land measuring 0.32 decimal of CS Plot No. 183 and CS Khatian No. 96 of Mouza Khanpur, PS Fatullah, District-Narayangonj along with other lands belonged to Manu as raiyati right; that Manu died leaving 2 sons namely Abdul Kader and Kudrat Ullah and only daughter Haytun Bewa; that thereafter Abdul Kader died leaving 2 sons Abdul Gani and Ali Hossain and they became owner of the land of their father as his heirs and successors; that Hay tun Bewa had transferred her share in the suit land along with other lands to Abdul Gani and Ali Hossain through registered deed being No. 1162 dated 31-1-1946 and that these Abdul Gani and Ali Hossain had acquired 1.128 acres of land by way of purchase and inheritance; that while Abdul Gani had been in possession of 0.564 acre of land in the aforesaid CS Khatian No. 96 he died leaving Mobarak Hossain, Asrafuddin, Nuruddin, Shafiuddin and defendant No.5, Akhiluddin as 5 sons and Sahera Begum, Jahanara Begum and Hena Begum as 3 daughters; that during SA operation the name of the heirs of Abdul Gani were recorded along with the name of heirs of Manu and SA Khatian No. 156 was correctly prepared; that in the said Khatian the name of Nazimuddin and Alimuddin were recorded as sons of Abdul Gani but in fact they were not the sons of Abdul Gani; that Ali Hossain, Mobarak Hossain, Asrafuddin Ahmed and Nuruddin Ahmed had transferred 0.37 acres of land of plot No. 183 to one Shahbuddin Miah through registered deed No. 1950 dated 8-3-1963 and delivered possession to him; that while Shahbuddin Miah had been in possession of entire 3'7 decimal of land of CS Plot No. 183 including other lands of other plots, he had transferred the said land to one Iman Ali and his sister Gedi Bibi vide registered deed No. 2696 dated 7-5-1965, that while aforesaid Iman Ali and Gedi Bibi had been in possession of the said land for more than 12 years Gedi Bibi died leaving his brother Iman Ali and her share in the suit land devolved upon her brother and while Iman Ali became the owner of said 0.37 acre of land of suit plot No. 183, he again transferred 5 decimal of land to plaintiff No. 8 through registered deed being No. 8776 dated 8-7-1976; that plaintiff No. 8 mortgaged the suit property with the Bangladesh Krishi Bank; Fatullah Branch; that Iman Ali also had transferred 0.04 and 1/4 acre of land to Mosammat Suraiya Begum vide registered deed No. 8801 dated 17-12-1981; and on the same date he further had transferred 0.06 and 1/4acre of land to Mosammat Jesmin Akter@ Layla, Most. Najnin Akter @ Dipali, Most. Nasrin Akter & Shamoli and Shahinur Islam vide registered deed being No. 8802 dated 17-12-1981; that Iman Ali also had transferred 0.04 and 1/4 acre of land to Suraiya Begum vide kabala deed No. 8778 dated 15-12-1981; he further transferred 0.06 and 1/4 acre of land to Jesmin Akter and others vide registered deed No. 43 dated 4-1-1982 and on the same date he also transferred 0.06 acre of land to Md Anower Uddin vide registered deed No. 44 and thus the purchasers became owners and possessors of 0.32 acre of land of CS Plot No. 183; that while Anower Uddin, Most Suraiya Begum, Most. Jesmin Akter, Nasrin Akter, Most. Najnin Akter and Md Shahinur Islam had been in possession of 0.27 acres of land of CS plot No. 183, Most Jesmin Akter @ Layla and Most. Najnin Akter @ Dipali had transferred 0.05 acre of land to plaintiff No.1, Most. Rowshan Ara Beguinfrom CS Plot No. 183 corresponding to RS Plot No. 259 vide registered deed No. 5899 dated 5-7-1986; that on the same date Md Anoweruddin had transferred 0.06 acre of land to Kazi Sharif Ahmed from the aforesaid suit plot vide registered deed No. 5900; that Most. Suraiya Begum further transferred 0.04 and 1/4 acre of land to plaintiff No.1 vide registered deed No. 7415 dated 28-12- 1988; on the same date she further had transferred 0.04 and 1/4acre of land to Kazi Sharif Ahmed vide deed No. 7416; that Most. Suraiya Begum further transferred 0.0750 acre of land of aforesaid CS Plot No. 183 to Kazi Sharif Ahmed on being appointed as guardian of her minor children Nasrin Akhter and Shahinur Islam through case No. 53 of 1987 of the 2nd Court of Joint District Judge, Narayangonj vide deed No. 1233 dated 18-3-1991; that Kazi Sharif Ahmed became owner of 0.1775 decimal ofland and Rowshan Ara Begum became owner of 0.0925 acre of land and separate mutation khatian were prepared in their respective names; thereafter they dug pond and constructed houses by filling earth on their purchased land; they also took electricity and gas connection and they lived in the said houses with their family members and also possessed the same through different tenants and, enjoying usufructs from the trees; that Kazi Sharif Ahmed died leaving wife plaintiff No. 1 and 6 sons plaintiff Nos. 2-7 and 0.1775 acre of land of Kazi Sharif Ahmed devolved upon the plaintiffs by inheritance and also by purchase; that plaintiff Nos. 1-7 became owner of 0.27 acre of land; they mutated their names; separate joma was also prepared in their names and that they had been in possession of the said land for more than 12 years within the knowledge of defendant Nos. 3- 7; that during RS operation the land of CS Plot No. 183 corresponding to RS Plot No. 259 was correctly prepared in the name of Iman Ali predecessor in interest of the plaintiff Nos. 1-7 in RS and SA khatian; that the plaintiffs had been in possession of their 0.32 acres of land; that defendant No.5 have/had no right, title and interest in any part of the plaintiffs 0.32 acres of land; on the 1st week of May plaintiff No.2 came to know that defendant No.1, Bank has taken all steps to sell the suit property in auction; that after search in the Court of Joint District Judge and Artha Rin Adalat defendant No, 2 came to know that defendant No. 4 in the name of his business enterprise (defendant No.3) mortgaged the suit property to defendant 'No.1, Bank and that defendant No. 1 obtained decree on 27-9-2000 in Artha Rin Suit No. 59 of 1893 against defendant Nos. 3 and 4 for realization of the loan money for an amount of Taka 23,52,402 and final decree was obtained on 25-3-2001; that plaintiffs thereafter filed an application under Order XXI, rule 58 of the Code of Civil Procedure before the Artha Rin Adalat for releasing their property from attachment and the said application was registered as Miscellaneous Case No. 17 of2002; the learned Joint District Judge after hearing by his judgment and order dated 26-10-2002 rejected the said application; that from the plaint of Artha Rin Suit No. 59 of 1993 the plaintiffs came to know that defendant Nos. 3 and 4 took loan of Taka 39,50,000 and that as security of the said loan defendant No.5 mortgaged 0.33 acre of land of suit plot No. 183 in favour of defendant No. 1 on 21-11-1991; that defendant No.5 had no authority to mortgage the suit property to defendant No. I; that the plaintiffs and their predecessor-in-interest purchased the suit property from lawful owner and they are the heirs and successors of Abdul Gani who became owner of the suit property by purchase through the deed of the year 1963;that plaintiffs have been in possession of the suit property for more than 40 years; that the cause of action of the suit arose from 1st week of May, 2002 and on 18-5-2002 when the defendant No.1 obtained preliminary decree on 27- 9-2000 and final decree on 25-3-2001 and lastly on 26-10-2002 when the Artha Rin Adalat rejected their Misc. Case No. 17 of 2002. 

 4. By amending the plaint the plaintiffs stated that Md Akhiluddin predecessor of defendant Nos. 5(ka)-5(Uma) along with 6 others filed partition Suit No. 23 of 1996 for partition of their L88 acres of land including 0.37 acres of land of CS Plot No. 183 and that in the partition suit Md Akhiluddin Ahmed claimed saham of 0.07 and 3/5 acre of land of CS Khatian No. 96 and thus the mortgage of 0.33 acre of land by Md. Akhiluddin did not arise while he had no right, title and interest over 0.33 acre of land of suit plot No. 183. 

 6. One Manu was the original owner of 0.37 acres of land of CS Plot No. 183; that while Abdul Gani had been in possession of the said land by way of purchase? he died leaving defendant No.5, Akhiluddin as his son and that while Akhiluddin had been in possession of the said land along' with other lands by amicable partition with the other co-sharers, he mutated his name in respect of .33 acre of land of suit plot No. 183 and joma was separated in Khatian No. 156; that while Akhiluddin had been in possession of the said .land he mortgaged the said property on 21-11-1991 to defendant Nos. 1 and 2 through mortgage deed No. 5569 dated 21-11-1991 and received huge loan; he also executed a power of attorney on the same date vide deed No. 5572; that plaintiffs had no right, title and possession over the suit property; that the alleged title deeds of the plaintiffs are all false and collusive; that Akhiluddin had no co-sharer in his 0.33 acre of land; that Akhiluddin defendant No. 5 as son of Abdul Gani never transferred any land to plaintiffs or their predecessors; that plaintiffs in collusion with defendant Nos. 3-5 instituted this false suit to get rid of the debt of the bank; that plaintiffs' suit is hit by principle of res- judicata as because plaintiffs previously filed Misc. Case No. 17 of 2002 in respect of self-same property before the Artha Rin Adalat; Narayangonj which was rejected on 26-10-2002 and that for the self- same matter which was finally decided by the Court on 26-10-2002, the present suit for the same relief is not maintainable; that the suit is barred under section 20 of the Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003 and that the same is liable to be dismissed. 

 14. PW 4, Md Mofiz Uddin stated that plaintiffs, defendants and the suit land were known to him. There are trees and houses on the suit land. Those trees and the houses are standing therein since 1988. Except plaintiffs he saw none to possess the suit land. Me could not say the plot and khatian number of the suit property. 

 18. DW 1, Bimal Chandra Shaha is a Principal Officer, Rupali Bank Ltd., SK Road Branch, Narayangonj. He deposed on behalf of defendant Nos. 1 and 2. He stated that 0.37 acre of land of suit plot No. 183 originally belonged to Manu. Abdul Gani purchased the same from Manu and that defendant No.5 Akhiluddin is the son of Gani. Abdul Gani got the suit land by amicable partition among the co-sharers. Thereafter he separated khatian and mutated the suit land in his name vide Mutation Case No. 156/2. Mutation khatian has been marked as Exhibit Ka, OCR has been marked as Exhibit Kha, rent receipts has been marked as Exhibit Ga. Defendant took loan from Rupali Bank Ltd. SK Road Branch, Narayangonj. Defendant No.5, Akhiluddin was the guarantor of that loan. Against the said loan defendant No. 5 mortgaged the suit property in favour of defendant No. 1 vide mortgage deed No. 5569 dated 21-11-1991 and on the same date also registered a power of attorney vide No. 5572. Those two deeds filed and marked as Exhibit Gha and Uma. M/s Sundarban Trading did not repay the loan and, as such, obtained a decree against Akhiluddin and other defendants in Artha Rin Suit No. 59 of 1993. Photocopy of the judgment and decree of Artha Rin Suit have been marked as Exhibit Cha and Cha(1). Thereafter they filed Money Execution Case No. 44 of 2001. In that execution case plaintiffs filed a miscellaneous case being Misc. Case No. 17 of 2002 which was dismissed on contest on 26-10-2002. The certified copy of the judgment and order dated 26-10-2002 passed in Misc. Case No. 17 of 2002 has been filed and marked as Exhibit Chha. After disposal of the said miscellaneous case plaintiffs did not move the higher Court. Plaintiffs have no right, title and interest in the suit property. Akhiluddin never sold the suit property to anyone. Plaintiffs' claim is false. He denied that plaintiffs purchased the suit property from the sons and daughters of Akhi1uddin and that except Akhiluddin none had any right to sell the suit properly. Plaintiffs' rent receipts, khatian and all other documents are collusive and ineffective. Plaintiffs instituted the suit in collusion with defendant No.5 for misappropriating the defendants money. In his cross-examination he stated that they took legal advice from their lawyer as regards the mortgage deeds and power of attorney. The suit land was amicablely partitioned among the heirs of Abdul Gani. He could not say the date and year of amicable partition. He could not say whether the name of Akhiluddin was recorded in SA khatian or not. He also stated that the mutation parcha filed by them in the name of Akhiluddin is forged. Before granting loan he personally visited the suit land. It is not correct that since 1985-86 plaintiffs have been in possession of the suit property by constructing houses and planting trees and that they took electricity connection in the suit land. He denied the suggestion that defendant No.3 in collusion with the bank officials created the power of attorney in the name of Akhiluddin who had no right, title and interest in the suit land. It is not correct that defendant No.5 as grantor had no authority to create mortgage deed and power of attorney in favour of defendant Nos. 1 and 2 and that those power of attorney and mortgage deed are collusive and forged or that the defendant Nos. 1 and 2 have not acquired any right and title in the suit property on the basis of those power of attorney and mortgage deed. He could not say whether 3 sons of Abdul Gani and his brother Ali Hossain had transferred 0.37 acre of land of plot No. 183 to one Shahbuddin through registered deed No. 1950 dated 8-3-1963. He further could not say whether or not Shahbuddin transferred the said land to Iman Ali and his sister Gedi Bibi vide registered deed No. 2696 dated 7-5-1965 and that after the death of Gedi Bibiher brother Iman Ali inherited her property. He also failed to say whether the land of RS Plot No. 259 of RS Khatian No. 51 was prepared in the name of Iman Ali He also could not say whether plaintiffs have been in possession of the suit property by purchasing the same through different deeds of different dates since 1981-88 from the heirs of Iman Ali and they have been living therein by constructing houses. 

 19. It appears from the genealogy of the plaint and written statement that Manu was the owner of 1.88 acres of land including the suit land of CS Khatian No. 96. Thereafter he had died leaving 2 sons namely Abdul Kader and Kudrat Ullah and only daughter Hayatun Bewa. Abdul Kader became owner of 0.752 acre of land including the suit land. Thereafter he died leaving 2 sons, Abdul Gani and Ali Hossain who inherited the property of their father Abdul Kader. Hay tun Bewa had transferred her 0.376 acre of land through registered deed being No. 1162 dated 31-1-1946 (Exhibit 1 Ta) to Abdul Gani and Ali Hossain. While Abdul Gani and Ali' Hossain had been in possession of their inherited and purchased land, Abdul Gani died leaving 5 sons and 3 daughters named Mobarak Hossain, Asrafuddin, Nuruddin, Shafiuddin and defendant No.5, Akhiluddin and 3 daughters were Sahera Begum, Jahanara Begum and Hena Begum. Thereafter 3 sons of Abdul Gani namely Mobarak Hossain, Asrafuddin Ahmed and Nuruddin Ahmed and their uncle Ali Hossain had transferred 0.37 acre of land of suit plot along with some other non suited lands of that khatian to Shahbuddin vide kabala deed No. 1950 dated 8-3-1963 (Exhibit 1 Tha). While Shahabuddin Mia had 'been in possession of said 0.37 acre of land of Plot No. 183 he had transferred the same to one Iman Ali and his sister Gedi Bibi vide deed No. 2696 date 7-5-1965 (Exhibit 1). Gedi Bibi died leaving her brother Iman Aliand Iman Ali became the owner of entire 0.37 acre ofland of plot No. 183 and his name was prepared in RS Khatian No. 51 of RS Plot No. 259. The said RS khatian has been filed and marked as Exhibit 2. Thereafter Iman Ali transferred 0.32 acre of land to the predecessor -in- interest of the plaintiff Nos. 1-7 and 8 vide eight (8) registered sale deeds and those deeds have been filed and marked as Exhibit 1 (Ka) to l(Neo). Plaintiffs mutated their names and have been paying rents. The mutation khatian has been field and marked as Exhibit 3 (cha), 3 (Chha), 3(Uma) and Exhibit 11. The rent receipts have been filed and marked as Exhibit 3-3 (Tha), 9 and 9(Ka) CS and RS Khatian have been filed and marked as Exhibit 2(ka)- 2(Uma). Accordingly plaintiffs have been in possession of the suit land by constructing houses digging ponds and also by installing electricity and gas line in their own names. The gas bills and electricity bills have been filed and marked as Exhibit 4 and 5 series respectively. 

 20. The defendants claim that defendant No. 5 Akhiluddin, son of Abdul Gani had acquired the property by an amicable settlement among the co-sharers. A mutation khatian showing mutation in the name of Akhiluddin has been filed and marked as Exhibit Ka. There is no dispute between the parties as regards genealogy. It is admitted by the plaintiffs that defendant No.5, Akhiluddin is the son of Abdul Gani. Defendants further claim that defendant No.5 being owner of the suit property mortgaged the same through registered mortgage deed No. 5569 dated 21-11-1991 and that he also executed and registered a power of attorney on the same date being deed No. 5572. The mutation khatian No. 156 Exhibit ka is a genuine document. The DW 1 in his cross examination admitted that he could not say whether or not SA khatian was prepared in the name of Akhiluddin and that the mutation parcha submitted by them in the name of Akhiluddin is a forged document নালিশী এস এ খতিয়ানে অখিল উদ্দিনের নাম আছে কিনা জানিনা। অখিল উদ্দিনের নামীয় মিউটেশন পরচা (আমাদের দাখিলী ) জল। "PW7, Md Arifur Rahman, Assistant land Officer, Fatullah Union Land Office, stated that in connection with register-2 he submitted a report to the Assistant Commissioner (Land) who was directed by the Court to submit a report. The Report has been filed and marked as Exhibit 8. In that report PW 7 clearly stated that সূত্রস্থ স্বারককে বর্ণিত ১৮৫০/৯১ নং তাং ২২-৬-৯১ নামজারী জমাভাগ মোকদ্দমা মূলে বর্ণিত ১৪৮৪ নং খতিয়ানে জনাব অখিল উদ্দিন আহাম্মাদ, পিতা–মৃত-আব্দুল গনি এর নাম কোন খতিয়ান পাওয়া যায়না। From the said report Exhibit 8 it further appears that the name of Akhiluddin was not appeared in SA and RS khatian. 

 21. By amending the plaint plaintiffs stated that Akhiluddin and 7 others instituted a suit being Partition Suit No. 23 of 1996 for partition of their entire 1.88 acres of land of CS khatian No. 96 claiming their Saham in 0.0766 acre of land. The said suit was renumbered as Title Suit No. 11 of 2001 and the same was dismissed for default on 27- 3-2003. The certified copy of the judgment and decree has been marked as Exhibit 6(kha). The plaint of that suit has been filed and marked as Exhibit 6(ga). 

 22. From the documents and the evidence of the parties it appears that Akhiluddin had not acquired any right, title and possession in the land of suit plot No. 183. Already we have found that no mutation khatian was prepared in the name of Akhiluddin. His mutation khatian Exhibit ka is a fabricated document. Even SA and RS khatian was not prepared in his name and the same clearly shows that he had no right, title, interest and possession in Suit Plot No. 183 corresponding to RS Plot No. 259: The P.Ws. were not cross-examined as regards possession of Akhiluddin in the suit property. The statement of PWs as regards possession of the plaintiffs in the suit property were not cross-examined. Even the DW 1 also did not deny the possession of the plaintiffs in the suit property. So, conclusion can be drawn that defendant No. 5 mortgaged the property to defendant Nos. 1 and 2 as security of the loan of defendant Nos. 3 and 4 without having any right, title, interest and possession of the suit property. On the other hand the documents filed by the plaintiffs and the evidence and materials on record clearly show that plaintiffs have right, title, interest and possession in the suit property.
